name: MKL_LEADS_CONVERSION_JOBS
description: Lead Conversion Job Table. This table contains operating information of a Lead Conversion Job.

columns.name: SYNC_JOB_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the row (Primary Key).

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ESS request.

columns.name: LEAD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Lead which will be processed as part of the sync job.

columns.name: OPPORTUNITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Opportunity if the Conversion is successful.

columns.name: JOB_ITEM_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the row being processed.

columns.name: ERROR_DESC
columns.description: Error details if Lead fails to convert.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
